hero.subtitle: Self-hosted command center for domains, servers, hosting, uptime monitoring, email, and more. Open source and free forever.

features.title: Everything You Need
features.subtitle: Nine modules. One dashboard. Zero context-switching.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.description: Drag-and-drop bookmark board organized into categories. Quick access to all your resources.

domains.title: Domains & DNS
domains.description: Manage DNS records across Cloudflare, Hetzner, and GoDaddy from a single interface.

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: Monitor your VPS fleet with real-time CPU, RAM, and disk metrics. Start, stop, and restart with one click. Lightweight Python agent for detailed monitoring.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.description: Unified view of cPanel and Hostinger accounts. Track disk usage, bandwidth, databases, and account status.

uptime.title: Uptime Monitoring
uptime.description: HTTP, TCP, and Ping monitors with heartbeat visualization. Instant alerts when services go down. Configurable intervals and retries.

mail.title: Mail
mail.description: Full three-pane IMAP mail client built right in. Compose, reply, forward, manage folders — not just notifications, a real mail client.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Slack-like channels organized by categories. Receive webhook messages alongside team communication.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Centralized log viewer with severity filtering. Search, sort, and paginate through your infrastructure logs.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Alert management with severity levels and categories. Never miss a critical infrastructure event.

providers.title: Multi-Provider
providers.headline: All Your Providers, One Interface
providers.description: Stop juggling Cloudflare, Hetzner, GoDaddy, cPanel, and Hostinger dashboards. Inspoter aggregates them into a single, unified view.
bullets: DNS management across Cloudflare, Hetzner DNS, and GoDaddy
Server control for Hetzner Cloud with power actions
Hosting accounts from cPanel WHM and Hostinger

mail.title: Built-in Mail
mail.headline: A Real Mail Client, Not Just Notifications
mail.description: Inspoter includes a full three-pane IMAP mail client. Read, compose, reply, forward, manage folders — all without leaving the dashboard.
bullets: Multi-account IMAP support with folder navigation
Compose, reply, and forward with SMTP sending
Attachment support with lazy IMAP fetch
Webhook mailbox for automated inbound messages

monitoring.title: Server Monitoring
monitoring.headline: Real-Time Metrics from Every Server
monitoring.description: Deploy a lightweight Python agent via Docker and get instant CPU, memory, disk, and load metrics streamed to your dashboard.
bullets: CPU, RAM, swap, disk, and load average monitoring
Lightweight Docker agent — one command to deploy

clone.title: Clone
clone.description: Pull the repository to your server

configure.title: Configure
configure.description: Set your database URL and secrets in .env

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Multi-tenant isolation. Each team gets their own workspace with custom section visibility.

encryption.title: Encrypted Credentials
encryption.description: AES-256-GCM encryption for all provider API keys and passwords at rest.

webhooks.title: Webhooks In & Out
webhooks.description: Ingest events from any service. Push alerts and status changes to external endpoints.

sso.title: SSO Ready
sso.description: Authentik OIDC integration alongside traditional password authentication.

community.title: Your Data Stays Yours
community.description: Inspoter is open source and self-hosted. No vendor lock-in, no data leaving your infrastructure, no surprise bills.
